title: Sum of Mod of Linear
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

You are given integers $N,Q$ and integer sequences $A=(A_1,A_2,\ldots,A_N), B=(B_1,B_2,\ldots,B_N)$ of length $N$.

You are given $Q$ queries, so answer each of them. In each query, you are given an integer $x$; find the value of $\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^N ((x+A_i) \bmod B_i)$.

## Constraints

- $1\le N\le 5\times 10^5$
- $0\le A_i < B_i \le 5\times 10^5$
- $1\le Q\le 2\times 10^5$
- $0\le x\le 5\times 10^5$
- All input values are integers.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N
A_1 B_1
A_2 B_2
\vdots
A_N B_N
Q
\text{query}_1
\text{query}_2
\vdots
\text{query}_Q
```

The $i$-th query $\text{query}_i$ is given in the following format:

```
x
```

## Output

Print $Q$ lines.

The $i$-th line $(1\le i\le Q)$ should contain the answer to $\text{query}_i$.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

给定整数 $N,Q$，以及长度为 $N$ 的整数序列 $A=(A_1,A_2,\ldots,A_N), B=(B_1,B_2,\ldots,B_N)$。

给定 $Q$ 次询问，请回答每次询问。每次询问给定一个整数 $x$，求 $\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^N ((x+A_i) \bmod B_i)$ 的值。

## 约束条件

- $1\le N\le 5\times 10^5$
- $0\le A_i < B_i \le 5\times 10^5$
- $1\le Q\le 2\times 10^5$
- $0\le x\le 5\times 10^5$
- 所有输入值均为整数。

## 输入格式

输入通过标准输入以如下格式给出：

```
N
A_1 B_1
A_2 B_2
\vdots
A_N B_N
Q
\text{query}_1
\text{query}_2
\vdots
\text{query}_Q
```

第 $i$ 次询问 $\text{query}_i$ 以如下格式给出：

```
x
```

## 输出格式

输出 $Q$ 行。

第 $i$ 行 $(1\le i\le Q)$ 应包含 $\text{query}_i$ 的答案。

samples.note:
The answer to each query is obtained as follows.

- In the $1$-st query, $x=0$, so the answer is $((0+1)\bmod 3)+((0+2)\bmod 5)+((0+0)\bmod 1)=1+2+0=3$.
- In the $2$-nd query, $x=1$, so the answer is $((1+1)\bmod 3)+((1+2)\bmod 5)+((1+0)\bmod 1)=2+3+0=5$.
- In the $3$-rd query, $x=2$, so the answer is $((2+1)\bmod 3)+((2+2)\bmod 5)+((2+0)\bmod 1)=0+4+0=4$.
- In the $4$-th query, $x=3$, so the answer is $((3+1)\bmod 3)+((3+2)\bmod 5)+((3+0)\bmod 1)=1+0+0=1$.
- In the $5$-th query, $x=200000$, so the answer is $((200000+1)\bmod 3)+((200000+2)\bmod 5)+((200000+0)\bmod 1)=0+2+0=2$.
